task: Resume the interrupted full-panel base volatility LSTM from its best epoch to a maximum of 50 epochs, retain the W&B run and live curves, optionally compile, then run SiLU with matching settings; relocate project tests to models/tests. Review implementation and preflight before the production restart.
sources: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s models/tests -p test_*.py (14 tests discovered; one import error because this venv lacks declared jsonschema)
rg --files -g test_*.py (15 files, all under models/tests)

findings.evidence: models/variance_fit.py validates selected hyperparameters before resume but does not compare the newly prepared training floor or split counts with the checkpoint. A database changed at the same path could silently resume weights and optimizer against a different panel; the current run's results.json records a database size and modification time, but this is not enforced by the resume path.
findings.fix: Check the checkpoint floor and training/validation counts against the freshly prepared data before loading the optimizer, and verify the recorded database version before the production restart.

findings.evidence: After all 15 test_*.py files moved under models/tests, README.md:13 and CONTEXT.md:138 still instruct running python -m models.test_training_smoke, which no longer exists.
findings.fix: Change both examples to python -m models.tests.test_training_smoke.
